description: How to add @mestakara/ui to a React, Next.js, or any other React-based app.

requirements.title: Requirements
requirements.frameworks: Next.js (App Router / Pages Router), Vite + React, Remix, or any other React-based framework

registry.title: 1. Connect the registry
registry.description: This package lives in a private npm registry. Add the line below to the .npmrc file of your app. Replace <URL_REGISTRY> with your team's registry address.

styles.title: 3. Import the stylesheet
styles.description: Import Tailwind first, then the design system stylesheet. Every color, typography, radius and shadow token becomes available as a Tailwind class.

fonts.title: 4. Install the fonts
fonts.description: The design system uses Fraunces and Plus Jakarta Sans. Easiest way: install the Fontsource packages and import them once in your app entry.

nextjs.title: Next.js note
nextjs.description: Every component file already starts with "use client", so components work directly in Server Components (e.g. app/page.tsx) without a wrapper. Event handlers such as onClick still belong in your own Client Components.

optional.title: 6. Optional
optional.form: Form uses react-hook-form. Install it only if you need Form, and import it from @mestakara/ui/form (it is not in @mestakara/ui).
optional.toaster: For toast notifications, place <Toaster /> once at the app root, then call toast() from anywhere.

local.title: Trying it without a registry
local.description: Until the registry exists, pack the package into a .tgz file in the design system repo, then install that file in your app.
